description: This file defines the OrderFacade interface for managing order-related operations in an e-commerce system, including order initialization, processing, shipping, validation, and retrieval of order details.

classes.name: OrderFacade
classes.description: Interface defining order management operations such as initialization, processing, shipping, validation, and retrieval.

methods.name: initializeOrder
methods.description: Initializes a new order for a given store, customer, shopping cart, and language.

methods.name: refreshOrder
methods.description: Refreshes or updates an existing order with current store, customer, shopping cart, and language data.

methods.name: calculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total summary of an order, used in website and API contexts.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes a valid order, optionally with an initial transaction.

methods.name: initEmptyCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new empty customer object for anonymous users.

methods.name: getShipToCountry
methods.description: Retrieves list of countries available for shipping to for a store.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Generates a shipping quote based on customer, cart, order, store, and language.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a shipping summary from a shipping quote for order total calculation.

methods.name: validateOrder
methods.description: Validates an order, including binding results and messages.

methods.name: getReadableOrder
methods.description: Fetches a readable order object by order ID.

methods.name: getReadableOrderList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of readable orders for a customer or store.
